name: Through the Dark We Go
source:
There once was a girl from Nantucket,
Who carried a bright golden bucket...

You are her unseen guide — the quiet voice that helps her through the dark.
Every choice you make shapes her fate: will she trust you, or lose her way? 

[From [url=https://teharra-rose.itch.io/through-the-dark]itch.io[/url]]
